Policies and Initiatives.title: BoldCap-backed Pramaana Labs raises $27 Mn led by Khosla Ventures
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Pramaana Labs, an AI verification and accountability platform, has raised $27 million in a seed funding round led by Khosla Ventures. The round also saw participation from notable investors such as Accel, Boldcap, and Premji Invest. The funds will be used to train models, hire AI researchers, and expand its network of domain experts across regulated industries.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Haryana CM launches AI sandbox in Gurugram to accelerate Antyodaya-centric governance
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Haryana's Chief Minister has launched an AI sandbox in Gurugram to accelerate governance focused on Antyodaya, a vision for a Developed India. The initiative will allow government departments to present challenges for innovators to develop and test solutions, driving public welfare and governance through technology. The World Bank will provide assistance in skill development as part of this effort.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Delhi govt signs pact with IIT Kanpur for AI-operated air pollution monitoring system
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Delhi Government has signed a memorandum of understanding with IIT Kanpur's AIRAWAT Research Foundation to develop an AI-driven air quality management system. The system aims to improve pollution monitoring and forecasting in Delhi. The partnership is between the Delhi Government's Environment Department and IIT Kanpur.

Policies and Initiatives.title: ONODA Kimi, Dr Jitendra Singh deepen India–Japan partnership in frontier technologies
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh and Japan's Minister ONODA Kimi held talks in New Delhi to strengthen India-Japan cooperation. The discussions focused on advancing collaboration in key areas such as quantum science, AI, and medical research. The meeting aimed to deepen the partnership between the two countries in frontier technologies.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Dharmendra Pradhan opens IIT Madras tech summit in Delhi
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan inaugurated the IIT Madras Technology Summit 2026 in Delhi. The summit focuses on deep-tech and industry collaboration, bringing together key stakeholders in the field. The event aims to foster innovation and partnerships between academia and industry.

Policies and Initiatives.title: ‘Leap into future’: Delhi govt plans to set up two AI centres of excellence; governance, innovation in focus
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Delhi government plans to establish two AI centres of excellence, focusing on governance and innovation. These centres aim to drive progress and improvement in various sectors through artificial intelligence. The initiative is seen as a significant step towards embracing the future of technology and governance.

Policies and Initiatives.title: ‘Vidhan Sathi’ AI chatbot to help MLAs with Budget
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Delhi Legislative Assembly has introduced an AI-powered chatbot called 'Vidhan Sathi' to assist MLAs with real-time analysis of bills and legislative records. The chatbot is set to be rolled out during the upcoming Budget session, which starts on March 23. The initiative aims to provide MLAs with easier access to information and analysis to aid in their decision-making process.

Policies and Initiatives.title: In AI, India sees opportunity and blueprint of tomorrow: PM Modi
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi views Artificial Intelligence as a significant opportunity for India and a blueprint for its future. He emphasized the importance of youth participation, human-centric innovation, and skilling in AI development. Modi also stressed the need for human oversight and inclusive growth to guide the direction of AI.

Policies and Initiatives.title: One year, 12 startups: India AI Mission faces its first real test
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The India AI Mission is facing its first major test as government-backed startups prepare to showcase their models at the India AI Impact Summit. The event comes as shifting AI economics are putting New Delhi's compute-led strategy under scrutiny. The summit will feature 12 startups that have been supported over the past year, marking a critical milestone for the mission.

Policies and Initiatives.title: In face-recognition first, Delhi Police personnel to wear AI smart glasses in R-Day crime fight
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Delhi Police personnel will wear AI smart glasses equipped with face-recognition technology to enhance security during the Republic Day celebrations. This initiative marks a first in the use of AI-powered smart glasses for face recognition in law enforcement. The smart glasses aim to help police identify and prevent potential crimes.

Policies and Initiatives.title: HCLTech Partners With Carahsoft To Drive IT Efficiencies in US Public Sector
Policies and Initiatives.summary: HCLTech has partnered with Carahsoft to drive IT efficiencies in the US public sector. Additionally, HCLTech has also partnered with Team Global Express to digitize multimodal logistics using AI. These partnerships aim to leverage technology to improve operations and efficiency.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Salman Khan gets Delhi HC notice: Chinese AI app files plea over order on personality rights
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Delhi High Court has issued a notice to Salman Khan in response to a plea by a Chinese AI app seeking to overturn an interim injunction granting Khan personality rights. The AI platform claims the order negatively impacts its operations. Khan has been directed to file a reply to the plea within four weeks.

Policies and Initiatives.title: WEF Davos: Karnataka holds talks with Bharti, PayPal, Mistral AI on expansion
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Karnataka held talks with companies like Bharti, PayPal, and Mistral AI at WEF Davos to discuss expansion opportunities. The state pitched investment opportunities in areas such as data centres and AI hubs. Deputy CM Shivakumar promoted Bengaluru as the "city of the future" to attract international investment.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Tagbin’s Immersive Media Platform Finds Enterprise Niche In The AI Age
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Tagbin, an immersive technology and AI startup, has found a niche in the enterprise sector with its innovative platform. The company has worked on notable projects, including designing a virtual statue of Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose. Tagbin's platform utilizes immersive media to create engaging experiences, catering to the growing demand for interactive technologies in the enterprise space.

Events.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Heading to Delhi's Bharat Mandapam? Here’s how to avoid getting into traffic jam
Events.summary: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is being held at Delhi's Bharat Mandapam, with traffic curbs in place to manage the event. While Day 1 saw some localized jams near the venue, the expo's public opening on Day 2 is expected to have no official road closures. VIP movement on Day 3 may cause brief traffic disruptions on Mathura Road, but Day 5 is expected to have no restrictions.

Events.title: CPRG to host key policy dialogues at India AI Impact Summit-2026
Events.summary: CPRG will host the India AI Impact Summit-2026 in Delhi from February 16-20, aligning with PM Modi's vision. The summit will address AI's impact on employment, education, data governance, and institutional transformation through key policy dialogues. The event will feature prominent policymakers, experts, and ministers, including Jitin Prasada, Ashish Sood, and Nishikant Dubey.

Events.title: AI Impact Summit in Delhi: What to know — dates, venue, security, traffic and global buzz
Events.summary: New Delhi will host the AI Impact Summit 2026 from February 19-20, expecting 1.5 lakh delegates, including global leaders like French President Macron. The event will have high-security measures in place, along with traffic diversions in central Delhi from February 18-20. The summit coincides with Class XII board exams, which may be affected by the security and traffic arrangements.

Events.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman likely to visit India in Feb: ChatGPT maker expected at India AI Impact Summit 2026 - What we know so far
Events.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is expected to visit India in mid-February for the India AI Impact Summit. The summit is scheduled to take place from February 16-20, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. Altman's visit is anticipated to be a key part of the event, which will focus on the impact of AI in various sectors.

Events.title: AI Impact Summit next month, PWD to beautify Delhi
Events.summary: The AI Impact Summit is scheduled to take place next month, although details about the event are scarce. Meanwhile, the Public Works Department (PWD) has announced plans to beautify Delhi. The connection between the AI summit and the PWD's beautification project is not specified in the available information.

Major AI Developments.title: Hydroponic weed worth Rs 4.83 crore seized at Delhi airport; passenger arrested
Major AI Developments.summary: Customs officials at Delhi's IGI Airport seized hydroponic weed worth approximately Rs 4.83 crore from a passenger arriving from Bangkok. The passenger, an Indian national, was arrested under the NDPS Act after being intercepted on June 21. The seizure was made from the passenger who had arrived on Air India flight AI 2335.

Major AI Developments.title: IIM-Jammu signs MoU with DICCI
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian Institute of Management, Jammu, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Dalit Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (DICCI) to promote inclusive entrepreneurship. The partnership was announced during a national seminar on 'AI for Good Governance' in New Delhi. The collaboration aims to create a sustainable socio-economic impact, although specific details of the partnership were not disclosed.

Major AI Developments.title: Cyber extortionist arrested for blackmailing women using AI-morphed images: Delhi Police
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Police have arrested a cyber extortionist who used AI-morphed images to blackmail women. The individual allegedly created and used manipulated images to extort victims. The arrest marks a significant crackdown on cybercrime involving AI-generated content.

Major AI Developments.title: No AI Express flights from Noida, Hindon airports for now
Major AI Developments.summary: Air India Express flights will not be operating from Noida and Hindon airports at this time. The decision affects travel plans for those who were expecting to use these airports for Air India Express flights. No specific reason or timeline for resuming flights from these airports has been provided.

Major AI Developments.title: Fake recruiter used AI images to blackmail teenaged girl, arrested
Major AI Developments.summary: A fake recruiter used AI-generated images to blackmail a teenage girl, and has since been arrested. The individual utilized the AI images as a means to manipulate and extort the victim. The arrest was made following an investigation into the blackmailing incident.

Major AI Developments.title: Delhi man nabbed for AI-aided extortion of job seekers
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Police have arrested a 30-year-old man, Sourav, for allegedly using AI-based tools to extort young women by morphing their videos. The accused would obtain the videos by pretending to offer them jobs and then use the manipulated content for extortion. Sourav, a resident of Bhalaswa Dairy, worked at a private finance company.

Major AI Developments.title: Exclusive: Lumiq set to raise Rs 50 Cr in Series B round from Bajaj Finserv and Info Edge
Major AI Developments.summary: Lumiq, a Noida-based data analytics and AI platform, is set to raise Rs 50 crore in a Series B funding round led by Bajaj Finserv Ventures, with participation from existing investor Info Edge. This funding round marks the company's first in nearly four years, following its $5.5 million Series A raise in 2022. The investment is valued at around $5.2 million.

Major AI Developments.title: He was a shooting coach in Delhi. Then AI exposed his 25-year double life
Major AI Developments.summary: A shooting coach in Delhi was found to be leading a double life, which was exposed by AI after 25 years. The AI technology uncovered the coach's hidden life, revealing a shocking truth. The discovery has brought to light the coach's secret life, spanning over two and a half decades.

Major AI Developments.title: Gurgaon deploys IIT-backed AI sewer sensors in posh colonies to stop monsoon waterlogging
Major AI Developments.summary: Gurgaon has deployed AI-powered sewer sensors, backed by IIT, in affluent colonies to prevent waterlogging during the monsoon season. The sensors utilize artificial intelligence to monitor and manage sewer systems, helping to mitigate flooding. This initiative aims to provide a more effective solution to the city's recurring waterlogging issues.

Major AI Developments.title: Video generation startup TrueFan AI raises $10 Mn in Series A round
Major AI Developments.summary: TrueFan AI, a video generation startup, has raised $10 million in a Series A funding round led by Baring Private Equity Partners India and Z3 Partners, valuing the company at $40 million. The funding round also saw participation from existing investors IAN Alpha Fund and 3Lines Venture Capital. The new capital will be used to support international expansion and develop real-time AI video agents.

Major AI Developments.title: Disabled flyer claims AI deplaned her over fit-to-fly certificate
Major AI Developments.summary: A disabled flyer was deplaned from a connecting Delhi-Bhuj flight by Air India due to a fit-to-fly certificate issue. The passenger claimed that Air India did not request the certificate for her initial Frankfurt-Delhi journey. The incident occurred when she was about to board her connecting flight from Delhi to Bhuj.

Major AI Developments.title: Healthcare startup MediElaj raises pre-seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: MediElaj, a healthcare startup, has raised approximately $100K in a pre-seed round from friends and family. The founders have also invested nearly $500K in bootstrapping the company's technology platform and operational capabilities. The funds will be used for product development, kiosk prototyping, and preparation for pilot deployments to drive scalable growth.

Major AI Developments.title: 'Rejected my friend request': Delhi man creates 10 fake accounts, uploads 100 obscene AI-generated photos of Ahmedabad woman
Major AI Developments.summary: A Delhi man was arrested for creating 10 fake social media accounts and uploading 100 AI-generated obscene photos of an Ahmedabad woman and her mother. The accused's actions were reportedly in response to the woman rejecting his friendship request on Instagram. The man's campaign of harassment and defamation was halted by Ahmedabad cybercrime police.

Major AI Developments.title: Gurgaon homebuyer gets Rs 27 lakh payout. How real estate body used used Google AI for valuation
Major AI Developments.summary: A Gurgaon homebuyer received a payout of Rs 27 lakh with the help of a real estate body. The real estate body utilized Google AI for valuation in this case. The use of Google AI facilitated the valuation process, leading to the significant payout for the homebuyer.

Major AI Developments.title: Former Reliance, Flipkart and Cashify executives’ home services startup Eazzy raises angel funding
Major AI Developments.summary: Home services startup Eazzy has raised over $440K in an angel funding round from industry founders and corporate leaders. The fresh capital will be used to strengthen its technology platform, expand operations, and build AI-powered service solutions. Eazzy, founded by former executives of Reliance, Flipkart, and Cashify, currently offers repair and maintenance services in Gurugram and plans to expand into new categories.

Major AI Developments.title: Flexprice raises $1.5 Mn seed round led by Shastra VC
Major AI Developments.summary: Flexprice, a usage-based billing startup, has raised $1.5 million in a seed funding round led by Shastra VC. The fresh capital will be used to expand into the US and Europe and develop new products, including metering and financial reporting tools. Founded in 2024, Flexprice provides open-source billing infrastructure for AI-native and API-first companies.

Major AI Developments.title: Shipsy crosses $25M in ARR as demand for AI solutions for logistics grows
Major AI Developments.summary: Shipsy, a Gurugram-based startup, has reached $25M in annual recurring revenue (ARR) due to increasing demand for its AI logistics solutions. The growth is driven by rising labour costs and driver shortages in regions such as Europe, the UK, and Australia. This milestone highlights the expanding need for intelligent logistics solutions in the industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Can the Indian Copyright Act Accommodate Fully Autonomous AI Generated Output?
Major AI Developments.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed the Registrar of Copyright to consider registering a fully AI-generated artwork under Indian copyright law, sparking debate on non-human authorship. The Indian Copyright Act's architecture and provisions are fundamentally human-centric, making it challenging to accommodate fully autonomous AI authorship. The case raises questions about whether the Act can be adapted to recognize AI-generated output as eligible for copyright protection.

Major AI Developments.title: From AI art to wall decor: Artiure is helping Indian artists monetise their work
Major AI Developments.summary: Artiure, a Gurugram-based company, is creating a marketplace for digital and generative art. The platform helps Indian artists monetize their work by turning it into physical products. This enables artists to achieve financial inclusion and access global markets.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s AI job postings surge nearly 6x since 2019
Major AI Developments.summary: India's artificial intelligence job postings have grown nearly six-fold since 2019, driven by the country's expanding role as a global AI talent and execution hub. This surge in AI-led hiring is expected to reshape India's office market, with demand for flexible workspaces predicted to witness strong growth over the next few years. The country's knowledge-economy office stock may see an additional demand of 79 million square feet between 2025 and 2030.

Major AI Developments.title: Technical snag grounds AI flight to Delhi
Major AI Developments.summary: An Air India flight to Delhi was grounded due to a technical snag. The issue forced the cancellation of the flight, although details on the nature of the snag were not provided. The incident highlights the ongoing challenges faced by Air India in maintaining its fleet and ensuring smooth operations.

Major AI Developments.title: Will it rain in your neighbourhood? New AI tool offers 10-day forecasts for every 1km across UP
Major AI Developments.summary: A new AI tool offers 10-day weather forecasts for every 1km area across Uttar Pradesh, providing hyperlocal predictions. The tool aims to serve various sectors, including agriculture, water resource management, disaster relief, and urban planning. It can help authorities and residents make informed decisions with its precise and localized weather forecasts.

Major AI Developments.title: Enterprise intelligence startup SCIKIQ secures $1.5 Mn in pre-Series A
Major AI Developments.summary: Enterprise intelligence platform SCIKIQ has raised $1.5 million in a pre-Series A funding round led by Triton Fund II. The funds will be used to support global expansion, strengthen AI capabilities, and scale the platform. SCIKIQ is an AI-native platform that helps enterprises convert fragmented data into business-ready intelligence, founded in 2023 by Gaurav Shinh and Rohit Kumar.

Major AI Developments.title: 523 graduates, future docs set to meet public healthcare pressure
Major AI Developments.summary: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in Delhi held its 51st convocation, graduating 523 students who will help meet public healthcare demands. The event emphasized the importance of empathy in healthcare, despite advancements in artificial intelligence (AI). These new graduates are expected to make a significant impact in the healthcare sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Fashinza co-founder Pawan Gupta quits
Major AI Developments.summary: Fashinza co-founder and former CEO Pawan Gupta has left the company to explore opportunities in artificial intelligence. Abhishek Sharma will continue as the sole founder and CEO of the B2B fashion supply chain startup. Gupta's exit was reportedly a personal decision and not related to the company's business performance.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Madras’s first tech summit held in New Delhi
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Madras held its first tech summit in New Delhi, marking a significant event for the institution. The summit aimed to bring together experts and showcase technological advancements, although specific details of the event are not provided. IIT Madras's decision to host the summit in New Delhi highlights its efforts to expand its reach and collaborate with other stakeholders in the tech industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Apna Mart lays off 10% of workforce, shifts base from Bengaluru to Gurugram
Major AI Developments.summary: Apna Mart, a grocery delivery startup, has laid off around 10% of its workforce, impacting 35-40 employees, as part of a restructuring exercise linked to AI adoption. The company is relocating its base from Bengaluru to Gurugram, with product and technology teams already moved. The layoffs were due to AI-led automation making some roles redundant and relocation not being feasible for certain employees.

Major AI Developments.title: CashKaro revenue grows 72% to Rs 600 Cr in FY26; narrows losses
Major AI Developments.summary: CashKaro, a cashback and affiliate commerce platform, reported a 72% year-on-year revenue growth to Rs 600 crore in FY26, up from Rs 348 crore in FY25. The company's gross merchandise value (GMV) for partner brands also increased to over Rs 10,000 crore in FY26, from Rs 6,000 crore in the previous year. CashKaro narrowed its losses, reporting an EBITDA loss of Rs 17 crore.

Major AI Developments.title: AI push to fight crimes: Senior Delhi Police officers to adopt 100 police stations
Major AI Developments.summary: Senior Delhi Police officers will adopt 100 police stations as part of an initiative to fight crimes using artificial intelligence. The move aims to leverage AI technology to enhance law enforcement capabilities. This adoption is expected to improve crime-fighting efforts in Delhi.

Major AI Developments.title: Google’s AI Hub in Visakhapatnam; Building the missing pipeline for women founders
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has launched an AI hub in Visakhapatnam, a key step in India's development of large-scale digital infrastructure. The hub aims to support the country's economic growth through AI technology. Additionally, Rebalance, a Gurugram-based organization, is providing support to women-led startups through mentorship and investor access.

Major AI Developments.title: GobbleCube’s co-founders dilutes over 70% stake post Series A
Major AI Developments.summary: GobbleCube, an AI-based brand analytics platform, has raised $15 million in a Series A round led by Susquehanna Venture Capital. This is the company's second funding round within a year, with existing investors InfoEdge Ventures and Kae Capital also participating. The co-founders' stake has been diluted by over 70% following these back-to-back funding deals.

Major AI Developments.title: Part II: Flower Nahi, Fire: Delhi HC Waters the Wrong Rights (Again!)
Major AI Developments.summary: The Delhi High Court has been criticized for its approach to personality rights, failing to distinguish between different forms of unauthorized use. This conflation of fan practices, commercial merchandise, and AI-driven misuse leads to an overbroad and flawed approach. Dr. Aakanksha Kumar's analysis highlights the need for a more nuanced understanding of these distinct categories.

Major AI Developments.title: Target to earn Rs 2 crore a month, AI use, raw material sourced from China: Inside fake Mounjaro racket Gurgaon ops
Major AI Developments.summary: A fake Mounjaro racket operating in Gurgaon aimed to earn Rs 2 crore per month. The operation utilized artificial intelligence and sourced raw materials from China. The racket's details have been exposed, revealing the extent of its illicit activities.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘AI will get better with age & practice’: How Delhi lawyers are adopting tech, but cautiously
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi lawyers are cautiously adopting artificial intelligence technology in their practices. They believe that AI will improve with time and experience, but are currently using it to supplement their work rather than replace it. The adoption of AI is being done in a gradual and careful manner to ensure it supports their legal work without compromising its quality.

Major AI Developments.title: 'DL and TS': Hyderabad doctor with 'James Bond-like switch' on BMW to flip no. plates arrested
Major AI Developments.summary: A Hyderabad doctor was arrested for drunk driving after police discovered his BMW had a hidden device to flip between Delhi and Telangana registration plates. The device, likened to a "James Bond-like switch," allowed the doctor to switch between "DL" and "TS" number plates, raising suspicions of road tax evasion. The doctor was charged with drunk driving, cheating, and impersonation after refusing to provide details to police.

Major AI Developments.title: UP eyes deep-tech leadership, CM Yogi pushes time-bound innovation roadmap
Major AI Developments.summary: The state of Uttar Pradesh aims to become a leader in deep technology, with a focus on areas such as AI, quantum, green hydrogen, and drones. A time-bound innovation roadmap has been pushed by Chief Minister Yogi to drive this initiative. The Noida hub and an IIT Kanpur-led ecosystem will play key roles in scaling and promoting global outreach.

Major AI Developments.title: Gurugram university hosts global summit on AI & law
Major AI Developments.summary: Gurugram University hosted a two-day international conference on the convergence of artificial intelligence and law, which concluded on Saturday. The conference saw active participation from scholars, experts, researchers, and students from across the country and abroad. The valedictory ceremony was attended by Raj Nehru, OSD to the Chief Minister of Haryana, as the chief guest.

Major AI Developments.title: Fashinza acquires Qckin to build tech-enabled manufacturing platform
Major AI Developments.summary: Fashinza, a fashion supply chain platform, has acquired Qckin, a design-to-delivery startup, to build a tech-enabled manufacturing platform. The acquisition aims to integrate technology-led sourcing with specialized manufacturing, enabling global fashion brands to produce faster and more cost-efficiently. This move strengthens Fashinza's manufacturing ecosystem and provides a more resilient supply chain amid geopolitical shifts and evolving trade dynamics.

Major AI Developments.title: Dam Good Fish raises strategic funding at Rs 30 Cr valuation
Major AI Developments.summary: Dam Good Fish, a seafood infrastructure company, has secured strategic funding at a valuation of around Rs 30 crore ($3.6 million). The fresh capital will be used to strengthen its AI-led systems, expand infrastructure, and enter new markets. The company aims to deliver ultra-fresh, naturally raised fish directly from dams to consumers using its technology-enabled platform.

Major AI Developments.title: Shirtless protest at AI Summit in Delhi: To track Youth Congress members, police seek videos recorded by media houses
Major AI Developments.summary: A shirtless protest occurred at an AI Summit in Delhi, prompting police to seek videos from media houses to track down Youth Congress members involved. The police are attempting to identify the protesters to take further action. The incident highlights the tensions between authorities and protesters at the summit.

Major AI Developments.title: Merak Ventures leads pre-Series A round in CredResolve
Major AI Developments.summary: CredResolve, a debt collections infrastructure company, has raised an undisclosed amount in a pre-Series A round led by Merak Ventures. Existing investors Unleash Capital Partners and CDM Capital also participated in the round. The funds will be used to expand operations to 15 states and scale its AI and voice capabilities.

Major AI Developments.title: AI-generated petition: Delhi court fines litigant Rs 20,000 for wasting its time
Major AI Developments.summary: A Delhi court has fined a litigant Rs 20,000 for submitting a poorly written petition that wasted the court's time. The court suspected the complaint was generated using artificial intelligence due to its incoherent phrases and grammatical errors. The fine aims to discourage frivolous filings and highlights concerns over the use of AI in creating legal documents.

Major AI Developments.title: Cedar Hill Capital leads $1.5 Mn round in fraud intelligence startup Sign3
Major AI Developments.summary: Cedar Hill Capital has led a $1.5 million funding round in Sign3, a fraud intelligence and risk management startup based in Gurugram. The investment is Cedar Hill Capital's third and second in AI-led enterprise technology, with participation from existing investor Smile Group and several angel investors. Sign3 was founded in 2022 and develops an AI-native customer intelligence platform for real-time fraud prevention.

Major AI Developments.title: AI-focused centres of excellence, new policies on drones and semiconductors among highlights in Delhi Budget 2026-27
Major AI Developments.summary: The Delhi Budget 2026-27 includes AI-focused centres of excellence as a key highlight. New policies on drones and semiconductors are also part of the budget. These initiatives aim to drive innovation and growth in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Magical Nest operator Raanro raises pre-seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Raanro Interior Technology, the parent company of Magical Nest, has raised Rs 4.12 crore in a pre-seed funding round at a pre-money valuation of Rs 60 crore. The round was participated by Stargazer Fund and several angel investors, including Kunal Shah and Ankit Nagori. The company will use the funds to develop an AI-powered platform for streamlining interior design workflows.

Major AI Developments.title: Hello Gurgaon, AI chatbot calling: Clear your municipal corporation dues, please
Major AI Developments.summary: The Gurgaon municipal corporation has introduced an AI chatbot to remind residents to clear their pending dues. The chatbot will facilitate payment collections and help reduce outstanding debts. Residents can use the chatbot to settle their municipal corporation dues conveniently.

Major AI Developments.title: 11 AI Companies in Delhi to Know
Major AI Developments.summary: There are 11 notable AI companies in Delhi that are making significant contributions to the field of artificial intelligence. These companies are working on various AI applications, including machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. The presence of these companies in Delhi highlights the city's growing importance as a hub for AI innovation and development.

Major AI Developments.title: AI summit: Interim bail for accused in ‘shirtless protest’
Major AI Developments.summary: A Delhi court granted interim anticipatory bail to Rajeev Kumar, an accused in the "shirtless protest" during the AI summit, until March 28. The court directed Kumar to join the investigation, with the order passed by Additional Sessions Judge Amit Bansal. Kumar is accused of participating in the protest, but the specific charges against him were not detailed.

Major AI Developments.title: Constems AI Systems raises $2 Mn led by Finvolve and India Accelerator
Major AI Developments.summary: Constems AI Systems has raised $2 million in a pre-Series A funding round co-led by Finvolve and India Accelerator. The round also saw participation from existing investors, including Cognify, AIF, and Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to drive product innovation, global deployments, and expansion into new markets, including Southeast Asia, Japan, and the Middle East.

Major AI Developments.title: CBSE to introduce computational thinking AI for classes three to eight
Major AI Developments.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) plans to introduce computational thinking and artificial intelligence (AI) for students in classes three to eight. This initiative aims to enhance students' problem-solving skills and prepare them for emerging technologies. The introduction of AI and computational thinking will be a part of the CBSE curriculum.

Major AI Developments.title: Protest during AI Summit: Two more held
Major AI Developments.summary: Two more individuals have been detained in connection with a protest that occurred during an AI summit. The protest's details and the charges against those held are not specified in the report. The incident is currently being investigated, with a total of two more people being taken into custody.

Major AI Developments.title: AI no longer a shortcut, it's part of students' daily study routine now
Major AI Developments.summary: A new study finds that nearly 70% of Class XI and XII students use AI tools on a weekly basis, incorporating them into their daily study routine. AI aids students in information search and writing, but they still rely on teachers and traditional preparation methods for important exams. The increasing use of AI among students has also raised early concerns about mental health impacts.

Major AI Developments.title: upGrad acquires early-talent marketplace Internshala
Major AI Developments.summary: upGrad, an integrated skilling and workforce development company, has acquired Internshala, an early-talent marketplace, for an undisclosed amount with 90% of the consideration as a stock swap. The deal values Internshala at around Rs 100 crore. upGrad plans to invest additional resources to grow Internshala's revenue from Rs 45 crore to Rs 100 crore or more over the next 18-24 months.

Major AI Developments.title: AI summit protest row: Delhi cops probe ‘larger & well-planned conspiracy’
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Police has arrested Indian Youth Congress president Uday Bhanu Chib in connection with a protest at the AI summit, suspecting a "larger and well-planned conspiracy". The crime branch is investigating the incident, which involved anti-PM slogans and a security breach attempt. Several individuals have been identified, arrested, or are being raided in other states as part of the ongoing probe.

Major AI Developments.title: 91 countries and global organisations join New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact
Major AI Developments.summary: Ninety-one countries and organisations have endorsed the New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact, which aims to promote equitable, trustworthy, and accessible AI. The declaration emphasizes global cooperation, open ecosystems, and inclusive growth under shared development principles. It was adopted following the AI Impact Summit 2026, highlighting the importance of collaborative efforts in shaping the future of AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Mukesh Ambani unveils Rs 10 lakh crore AI push, vows to make India a global intelligence power
Major AI Developments.summary: Mukesh Ambani has announced a Rs 10 lakh crore investment in artificial intelligence, aiming to make India a global leader in the field. The investment is part of a broader effort to establish India as a major player in the global AI landscape. Ambani unveiled the plan at the India AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi.

Major AI Developments.title: Protest at AI Impact Summit: Here’s what Delhi Police’s SIT, Crime Branch will probe
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Police's Special Investigation Team (SIT) and Crime Branch will investigate a protest that occurred at the AI Impact Summit. The probe will focus on the circumstances surrounding the protest, but specific details of the investigation have not been disclosed. The AI Impact Summit was the site of the disturbance, which prompted police intervention.

Major AI Developments.title: Voluntary commitment can make a bigger difference: MeitY secretary on AI summit declaration
Major AI Developments.summary: A declaration signed in New Delhi emphasizes the establishment of two platforms for global sharing of AI tools and principles. The declaration also includes a global network of scientific institutes committed to collaborating on AI research. This initiative aims to promote international cooperation and advancement in the field of artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: Delhi declaration urges democratic AI for social good
Major AI Developments.summary: India's vision for democratic AI for social good has gained support from 86 signatories, including the US, China, and the EU, through the Delhi declaration. This agreement aims to promote the use of AI for the betterment of society. The declaration is a significant step towards ensuring AI is developed and used responsibly.

Major AI Developments.title: BJP demonstration outside Congress HQ over AI Summit protest
Major AI Developments.summary: The BJP staged a demonstration outside the Congress headquarters in response to a protest at an AI Summit. The protest at the AI Summit sparked a backlash from the BJP, leading to the demonstration. The demonstration highlights the escalating tensions between the two parties over the AI Summit incident.

Major AI Developments.title: Congress used AI summit for its ‘gandi aur nangi’ politics: PM Modi
Major AI Developments.summary: PM Modi criticized the Congress for a "shirtless" protest at an AI summit in Delhi, calling it "dirty and shameless" politics. He accused the party of defaming India and hindering parliamentary proceedings. Modi also appreciated criticism of the incident from other opposition parties, indicating a divide within the opposition over the protest.

Major AI Developments.title: Court denies bail to 4 Youth Cong workers
Major AI Developments.summary: A Delhi court denied bail to four Youth Congress workers who staged a shirtless protest at an AI summit. The court cited the premeditated nature of the act and potential harm to India's image as reasons for the denial. The protest was deemed a violation of public order rather than protected dissent.

Major AI Developments.title: Himachal Youth Congress protests arrest of workers over AI summit stir
Major AI Developments.summary: Youth Congress members protested the arrest of their workers who demonstrated at an AI summit in Delhi, demanding their release and criticizing the government for suppressing dissent. The protesters also expressed embarrassment over the display of a Chinese robotic dog at the summit. They accused the BJP of hypocrisy in its handling of protests, sparking further controversy.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit: States of India showcase their AI strengths
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Impact Summit was held in New Delhi, featuring pavilions from various Indian states. These pavilions showcased the unique AI strengths and capabilities of each participating state. The event highlighted the diverse range of AI initiatives and innovations across different regions of India.

Major AI Developments.title: AI and hologram technology bring Lord Krishna and Arjuna to life at Delhi summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Reliance Industries showcased AI-generated holographic avatars of Lord Krishna and Arjuna at the AI Impact Summit in New Delhi. The holograms enabled interactive engagement with visitors, demonstrating the company's AI-driven innovations. This display highlighted the company's technological advancements across various sectors.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit: Traffic diversions in Delhi amid heavy visitor influx today
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi traffic police have announced restrictions from 9 am to 8 pm on Saturday due to the AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam. The restrictions will affect Bhagwan Dass Road, Purana Qila Road, and Mathura Road, with commuters advised to use alternate routes like Tilak Marg and Ring Road. Commuters are urged to plan ahead and follow traffic personnel's instructions to minimize disruptions.

Major AI Developments.title: Artificial intelligence, hologram tech bring ‘Arjuna’, ‘Lord Krishna’ at AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Reliance Industries showcased an AI-generated Mahabharat series at the AI Impact Summit in Delhi, featuring digital avatars of Krishna and Arjuna. The avatars allow visitors to interact with them by asking questions, providing a unique experience. The series, "Mahabharat: Ek Dharmayudh," is entirely created using artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit 2026: 88 countries, international organisations sign New Delhi Declaration - Full list
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI Impact Summit 2026 has led to the signing of the New Delhi Declaration by 88 countries and international organisations. This declaration aims to foster long-term partnerships and position AI as a key driver of economic growth. The summit is expected to catalyse international partnerships and promote AI as a key engine of global economic growth.

Major AI Developments.title: Indian universities showcase their AI strengths at India AI Impact Summit 2026
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi featured pavilions from 12 Indian universities, highlighting their artificial intelligence strengths. The event provided a platform for these universities to showcase their AI capabilities and advancements. Indian universities demonstrated their contributions to the field of AI through various exhibits and displays at the summit.

Major AI Developments.title: Youth Congress’ shirtless protest during AI Summit: Police foil BJP’s attempt to lay siege to Congress Office
Major AI Developments.summary: Youth Congress workers staged a shirtless protest during the AI Summit-2026 in New Delhi, prompting a counter-protest by BJP Yuva Morcha members who attempted to lay siege to the City Congress Office in Mysuru. Police personnel blocked the BJP members, foiling their attempt to besiege the office. The incident occurred in response to the Youth Congress' protest at the Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.

Major AI Developments.title: BJYM condemns Youth Congress conduct at AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) protested in Ongole and Tirupati against the Youth Congress's conduct at an AI summit. The protests were sparked by a shirtless demonstration during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's inauguration of the international summit in New Delhi. The BJYM burned an effigy of Rahul Gandhi as part of their protest.

Major AI Developments.title: Tension in Kurnool as BJP protests Youth Congress demonstration at Delhi AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Tension arose in Kurnool due to a BJP protest against a Youth Congress demonstration. The demonstration in question occurred at the Delhi AI Summit. The protest highlights the escalating political tensions between the two parties.

Major AI Developments.title: BJP workers protest outside Congress headquarters, detained
Major AI Developments.summary: BJP workers protested outside the Congress headquarters, accusing the party of disrupting the AI Summit and damaging India's image. Thousands of protesters, led by Delhi BJP leaders, participated in the demonstration, which resulted in brief detentions. The BJP criticized the Congress for prioritizing politics over national interest.

Major AI Developments.title: Lanstitut is using language to unlock global healthcare jobs for Indian professionals
Major AI Developments.summary: Lanstitut, a Delhi-based company, is addressing the global shortage of nurses and healthcare workers by using AI-driven training to overcome language barriers. The company aims to enable Indian professionals to access global healthcare jobs through ethical recruitment and language training. This initiative seeks to promote global mobility in the healthcare sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Andhra to sign agreements to strengthen AI infrastructure at New Delhi summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Andhra is set to sign agreements to strengthen its AI infrastructure at a summit in New Delhi. The agreements aim to enhance the state's artificial intelligence capabilities. The summit will facilitate partnerships to boost Andhra's AI ecosystem.

Major AI Developments.title: Delhi Traffic Police issues advisory for AI Impact Summit 2026; check affected areas, alternate routes
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Traffic Police has announced special traffic arrangements for February 20, 2026, due to the AI Impact Summit, with temporary restrictions in place during morning and evening hours. Key roads like Sardar Patel Marg and Mathura Road will be affected, and commuters are advised to plan their journeys accordingly. Alternate routes are recommended, and commuters should follow traffic personnel's directions to minimize disruptions.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact summit: Delhi Police issue advisory for restrictions due to VIP movement
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi traffic restrictions are in place from 8 am to 10 am and 5 pm to 9 pm due to the AI Impact Summit-2026. Several roads, including Sardar Patel Marg and Mathura Road, will be affected by the restrictions. Commuters are advised to use alternate routes and follow traffic personnel instructions to minimize disruptions.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s AI showcase draws to a close, New Delhi declaration to come today
Major AI Developments.summary: India's AI showcase has concluded, with a New Delhi declaration expected to be unveiled today. Over 70 countries have already signed the declaration, according to Union IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. The declaration's unveiling was delayed by a day, with the minister making the announcement at a concluding media briefing.

Major AI Developments.title: General Catalyst to invest $5 Bn in India in next five years
Major AI Developments.summary: US-based venture capital firm General Catalyst plans to invest $5 billion in India over the next five years, focusing on sectors like AI, healthcare, and fintech. The investment will be used to support new company creation efforts in India, according to General Catalyst CEO Hemant Taneja. This commitment marks a significant increase from the firm's earlier investments in the country.

Major AI Developments.title: From chatbots to pantograph sensors: Delhi Metro rolls out AI systems across its network
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Metro is implementing AI systems across its network, including chatbots and pantograph sensors. The introduction of these AI-powered technologies aims to enhance the overall efficiency and performance of the metro system. The rollout is part of Delhi Metro's efforts to leverage artificial intelligence for improved operations and passenger experience.

Major AI Developments.title: Local talent, global impact: AI Impact Summit showcases innovators from around the world
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Impact Summit in New Delhi featured innovations from startups and corporates from around the world. The event showcased local talent with global impact, highlighting cutting-edge AI solutions. Overseas startups and corporates were among those presenting their innovations at the summit.

Major AI Developments.title: India built what no one else did: Macron shares street vendor’s story
Major AI Developments.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron praised India's digital transformation at the India-AI Impact Summit 2026, citing a Mumbai street vendor's adoption of digital payments. He highlighted the importance of strategic AI cooperation with India, led by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Macron emphasized the need for innovation, sovereignty, and responsible technology in AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘Propaganda campaign against us’: Galgotias University after being told to pack its bags at AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Galgotias University faced embarrassment at the India AI Impact Summit after a robotic dog it claimed as an in-house innovation was revealed to be a commercially available Chinese product. The university's exhibit was removed by organizers to prevent controversy and maintain the integrity of genuine innovations on display. The university apologized for the confusion, attributing it to an ill-informed representative.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Expo extended till Saturday amid security curbs, but closed to public today
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI Impact Expo has been extended to Saturday due to security measures for global leaders attending on Thursday. The expo is closed to the public on Thursday, but will reopen after access restrictions are lifted, allowing more visitors to experience the exhibits. This extension balances international diplomacy with public engagement, following a successful Wednesday with high footfall.

Major AI Developments.title: AI app analysing coughs could close COPD diagnostic gaps in primary care, AIIMS study shows
Major AI Developments.summary: A new AI app that analyzes coughs may help close diagnostic gaps for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) in primary care settings. According to a study by AIIMS, the app has shown potential in improving COPD diagnosis. The technology could lead to earlier and more accurate detection of the disease in primary care.

Major AI Developments.title: AI summit brings Delhi to a crawl: 5,000 cops deployed, VVIP movements snarl traffic
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI summit in New Delhi caused significant traffic disruptions due to VVIP movements and security protocols. Over 5,000 police personnel were deployed to manage the situation, which led to severe congestion on major routes. The traffic chaos impacted commuters and their daily schedules across central Delhi.

Major AI Developments.title: Two maintenance workers arrested for theft at AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Two maintenance workers were arrested for theft at an AI Summit. The incident occurred in Delhi, according to a report by the Times of India. The workers were taken into custody in connection with the theft.

Major AI Developments.title: India announces commitments for inclusive and responsible AI
Major AI Developments.summary: India has introduced the 'New Delhi Frontier AI Impact Commitments', a set of voluntary pledges to promote inclusive and responsible AI development. The commitments aim to inform evidence-based policymaking by understanding real-world AI usage and evaluating multilingual AI models. This initiative particularly focuses on supporting the Global South through strengthened AI evaluations.

Major AI Developments.title: K’taka showcases AI strength at India AI Impact Summit, woos global tech leaders
Major AI Developments.summary: Karnataka showcased its AI capabilities at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, highlighting its leadership and global collaborations with companies like Anthropic. The state is positioning Bengaluru as a deep-tech hub, with a focus on startup support and pilot projects in healthcare. Karnataka Minister Priyank Kharge led the state's presentation, aiming to attract global tech leaders.

Major AI Developments.title: At AIIMS-Delhi, an Indo-French collaboration to use AI in brain research and diagnosis of neuro disorders
Major AI Developments.summary: AIIMS-Delhi is collaborating with French institutions to utilize AI in brain research and diagnosis of neuro disorders. This Indo-French collaboration aims to advance the field of brain research and improve diagnosis of neurological conditions. The partnership will leverage AI technology to enhance understanding and treatment of neuro disorders.

Major AI Developments.title: Traffic mess during AI Summit: Why Delhi Police have their task cut out
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Police face a significant challenge in managing traffic during the AI Summit. The event is expected to cause traffic congestion, and police must ensure a smooth flow of vehicles. Authorities are likely to implement special traffic arrangements to mitigate the disruption.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: A leap towards India’s AI future
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi showcased India's growing leadership in AI innovation, highlighting its transformative potential in various industries. Experts discussed AI's impact on commerce, defense, and creative industries, as well as collaborations driving secure digital payments and AI-assisted content creation. The summit aims to position India as a global leader in shaping the future of AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Fabless semiconductor startup Vervesemi raises $10 Mn in Series A round
Major AI Developments.summary: Vervesemi, a fabless semiconductor startup, has raised $10 million in a Series A funding round co-led by Ashish Kacholia and Unicorn India Ventures. The company, which had previously raised $500,000, will use the fresh capital to accelerate commercialization of its machine learning-enhanced analog signal chain IC portfolio. The funding will also support expansion of its IP portfolio, R&D capabilities, and market presence in Asia, the US, and other key markets.

Major AI Developments.title: Qualcomm to invest $150 Mn in Indian AI and tech startups
Major AI Developments.summary: Qualcomm plans to invest up to $150 million in Indian startups through its Strategic AI Venture Fund, focusing on artificial intelligence and deep technology. The investments will target companies across various stages and sectors, including automotive, IoT, and edge computing. The move aims to support Indian startups building AI and emerging technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR account for over half of India’s AI job openings: Report
Major AI Developments.summary: Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR, and Mumbai account for nearly 70% of India's AI-related job openings. These cities have a high demand for skills in software engineering, data science, and customer operations. Bengaluru and Delhi-NCR alone account for over half of the country's AI job openings.

Major AI Developments.title: Galgotias University, under fire over Chinese robodog, asked to leave AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Galgotias University was removed from the AI Impact Summit due to backlash over showcasing a Chinese robotic dog as its own. The university had claimed it was for educational purposes, but the government took action following national embarrassment. The incident led to the university's removal from the summit after a social media outcry.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘India, UK resolve to deepen cooperation in AI, next-generation telecommunications’
Major AI Developments.summary: India and the UK have agreed to deepen their cooperation in artificial intelligence (AI) and next-generation telecommunications. The two countries will explore collaboration in areas such as autonomous network management and AI-driven cybersecurity. They will also work together on spectrum innovation and non-terrestrial networks.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit: Avoid these routes today as Delhi Traffic Police issues fresh advisory
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Traffic Police has issued a fresh advisory due to the AI Impact Summit. Certain routes are expected to be congested, and commuters are advised to avoid them. The advisory aims to minimize traffic disruptions and ensure a smooth flow of traffic in the affected areas.

Major AI Developments.title: Delhi set to host first AI Film Festival: Check date, ticket rates, venue and dress code
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi is set to host its first AI Film Festival, which will include short films, expert panels, and awards. The event aims to cater to a diverse audience, including directors, tech enthusiasts, academics, and the general public. The festival's date, ticket rates, venue, and dress code have been announced.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit 2026: 6 strategic takeaways for CIOs
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi is the first major global AI gathering in the Global South, bringing together world leaders and tech giants. The summit aims to redefine how artificial intelligence is governed, deployed, and measured for public and business value. Key stakeholders are gathering to discuss strategic AI implementation and its impact.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit 2026: India's role in global AI transformation, jobs, and innovation
Major AI Developments.summary: India is poised to play a key role in the global transformation of AI, shifting from safety debates to real-world impact. The AI Impact Summit 2026 warns that automation will both erase and create jobs, emphasizing the need for startup-led employment and rapid upskilling. AI is seen as a strategic choice for India's future in areas such as education, healthcare, and the economy.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Expo powerful convergence of ideas, innovation, intent: PM Modi
Major AI Developments.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the India AI Impact Expo 2026 in New Delhi, emphasizing India's commitment to responsible and inclusive AI. The expo features 600 startups and 13 country pavilions, showcasing global technology collaborations. The event is being held at Bharat Mandapam, bringing together a convergence of ideas, innovation, and intent.

Major AI Developments.title: As AI-generated fake prescriptions 'grave threat to health', chemists write to PM Narendra Modi
Major AI Developments.summary: The All India Organisation of Chemists and Druggists has warned PM Narendra Modi about the public health threat posed by AI-generated fake medical prescriptions. Unregulated e-pharmacies are exploiting loopholes to sell restricted medicines with minimal checks. The organization is urging immediate regulatory action to address this issue.

Major AI Developments.title: Team at IGIA to aid global AI delegates
Major AI Developments.summary: A team has been set up at Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA) to assist global delegates attending an AI event. The team will provide support and facilitate the arrival and departure of international attendees. The move aims to ensure a smooth experience for AI delegates visiting from around the world.

Major AI Developments.title: Can’t afford delay in using AI for inclusive growth, says CEA Nageswaran
Major AI Developments.summary: CEA V Anantha Nageswaran emphasized the need for urgent adoption of AI to achieve inclusive growth. At the India AI Impact Summit 2026, policymakers including Nageswaran and Narendra Modi stressed the importance of education reforms and democratic access to AI. They called for coordinated national action to facilitate the adoption of AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Feb 16–20: Traffic curbs around Bharat Mandapam in Delhi for AI Summit could slow your commute; TOI helps you plan
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi commuters can expect significant traffic disruptions from February 16-20 due to the AI Impact Summit at Pragati Maidan. The event will bring stricter rules, diversions, and potential road closures, especially during VVIP movements. Commuters are advised to plan for extra travel time and consider alternative routes, such as the main north-south Ring Road corridor or the Metro, for smoother journeys.

Major AI Developments.title: Rely on human intel and not AI, says SC judge at moot court
Major AI Developments.summary: A Supreme Court judge emphasized the importance of relying on human intelligence over artificial intelligence. The judge made this statement at a moot court, highlighting the value of human judgment and expertise. This comment suggests a cautious approach to the increasing use of AI in legal and other fields.

Major AI Developments.title: Special armouries in hotels, snipers in position for AI summit in Delhi
Major AI Developments.summary: Security agencies have set up special armouries in select hotels in New Delhi to support commandos during the AI summit. These armouries will provide an uninterrupted supply of ammunition and essential equipment, allowing commandos to respond quickly in case of emergencies. Snipers are also in position as part of the robust security measures in place for the event.

Major AI Developments.title: Six anti-drone systems, four air defence guns: How 15,000 security personnel will secure AI Summit in Delhi
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI Summit in Delhi will be secured by 15,000 security personnel, utilizing six anti-drone systems and four air defence guns. This extensive security measure aims to ensure the safety of attendees at the summit. The large security presence reflects the importance of the event and the need for robust protection.

Major AI Developments.title: Delhi Live Updates: Elaborate traffic regulations kick in as AI Impact Summit underway; police designate alternate routes, transport modes
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI Impact Summit is currently underway in Delhi, prompting the implementation of elaborate traffic regulations. Police have designated alternate routes and transport modes to manage the expected traffic congestion. The regulations aim to minimize disruptions and ensure smooth traffic flow during the summit.

Major AI Developments.title: AI summit coincides with board exams: Delhi braces for security clamp, traffic curbs
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi is implementing strict security measures for the AI Impact Summit, deploying over 10,000 police officers, including 5,000 for traffic management. The city will experience restrictions and diversions on key roads, but essential services will have uninterrupted access. Special arrangements will be made to aid students taking board exams during this time.

Major AI Developments.title: Tele-robotics to transform healthcare via AI: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh
Major AI Developments.summary: Tele-robotics powered by AI is set to transform healthcare by enabling remote ultrasound examinations, allowing doctors to perform real-time scans on patients in remote locations. Developed by AIIMS Delhi, IIT Delhi, and the Ministry of Earth Sciences, the system has already been used to scan patients in locations like Antarctica. This technology has the potential for broader applications in challenging environments, aiding in critical medical decisions and reducing costly evacuations.

Major AI Developments.title: Rubrik chief says New Delhi summit can reposition AI as a tool for solutions, growth and inclusive progress
Major AI Developments.summary: India is set to host the AI Impact Summit, which can help reposition AI as a tool for solutions and growth. According to Rubrik CEO Bipul Sinha, the country can leverage its tech workforce, infrastructure investments, and applied AI expertise to shift the global AI narrative. This shift can focus on real-world solutions rather than risks associated with AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Tech to tulips: City gets ready for AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: The city is preparing to host an AI Summit, bringing together technology and innovation. The event is expected to showcase the latest advancements in artificial intelligence. Details of the summit, including its date and agenda, are not specified in the available information.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit 2026 in Delhi: Traffic advisory issued for school students as CBSE exams begin on Feb 17
Major AI Developments.summary: A traffic advisory has been issued in Delhi due to the AI Impact Summit 2026. The advisory is particularly relevant for school students as CBSE exams are set to begin on February 17. The summit and exams may cause traffic disruptions, prompting the need for alternative travel arrangements.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026 draws strong global response, 70 teams named finalists
Major AI Developments.summary: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 has drawn a strong global response, with over 4,650 applications from more than 60 countries. The government has announced 70 finalists across three global AI challenges ahead of the summit in New Delhi. This response highlights India's growing role in responsible artificial intelligence innovation.

Major AI Developments.title: Delhi Police issue traffic advisory ahead of AI Impact Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Police has issued a traffic advisory for the AI Impact Summit from February 16-20, which will involve road closures in New Delhi and surrounding areas. Essential services, medical vehicles, and metro services will operate normally, with priority given to essential services. Students with board exams can contact nodal officers for route assistance to minimize disruptions.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit 2026: Delhi Police issues traffic advisory for Feb 16-20; check suggested routes for airport, railway stations
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi Police has issued a traffic advisory for February 16-20 due to the AI Impact Summit 2026. The advisory includes suggested routes for traveling to and from the airport and railway stations during this period. Commuters are advised to plan their routes in advance to avoid potential traffic congestion.

Major AI Developments.title: NDMC ups security ahead of AI Summit in Delhi
Major AI Developments.summary: The New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) is enhancing security and preparations in Delhi ahead of the India AI Impact Summit-2026. The preparations include improved surveillance, waste management, and environmental monitoring, as well as beautification efforts. The summit aims to showcase India's leadership in artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: Rs 2 lakh crore AI hub to come up off Yamuna Expressway in 2 years
Major AI Developments.summary: A new AI hub worth Rs 2 lakh crore is set to be established off the Yamuna Expressway. The project is expected to be completed within two years, with the hub aiming to become a major center for artificial intelligence. The hub's development is anticipated to drive significant growth and innovation in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Tight security measures in place ahead of AI summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Delhi police have increased security for the India-AI Impact Summit, deploying 10,000 personnel to ensure safety. A multi-agency security plan is in place, including 5,000 officers for traffic management and special emergency medical services. Traffic diversions are planned, especially near 34 schools, to minimize disruptions during the summit.

Major AI Developments.title: Traffic Cops Bring Schools On Board For AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Traffic police are collaborating with schools to participate in an AI summit, aiming to promote awareness and education about artificial intelligence. The initiative brings together traffic cops and schools to explore the potential of AI in various fields. The summit is expected to foster a better understanding of AI among students and the community.

Major AI Developments.title: Challenge is not whether to use AI, but how to use it: Justice Karol
Major AI Developments.summary: Justice Karol states that the challenge is no longer about deciding whether to use artificial intelligence, but rather about determining how to effectively utilize it. This shift in perspective acknowledges the inevitability of AI integration and focuses on responsible implementation. The statement highlights the need for thoughtful consideration in AI adoption.

Major AI Developments.title: Union Minister lauds State’s education reforms at AI Conclave in Delhi
Major AI Developments.summary: Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan attended an AI Conclave in Delhi, where he praised Andhra Pradesh's education reforms. He visited a special stall set up by the Andhra Pradesh School Education Department, showcasing the state's initiatives. The event highlighted the state's efforts in transforming its education system.

Major AI Developments.title: Care.fi raises $8 Mn in Series A round led by July Ventures
Major AI Developments.summary: Care.fi, a healthcare-focused fintech startup, has raised $8 million in a Series A funding round led by July Ventures, with $5 million in equity and $3 million in debt financing. The round also saw participation from Peak XV Partners, Accion Venture Lab, and Sadev Ventures, among others. The funds will be used to expand operations into additional Indian cities.

Major AI Developments.title: GMC school gets AI lab for 238 female students
Major AI Developments.summary: A new AI lab has been established at a GMC school, specifically catering to 238 female students. The lab aims to provide these students with hands-on experience and training in artificial intelligence. This initiative is expected to enhance their skills and knowledge in the field of AI.

Major AI Developments.title: The AI Security Control Plane
Major AI Developments.summary: The AI Security Control Plane is a concept related to artificial intelligence security, with a specific focus or implementation in Delhi. This control plane aims to provide a centralized management system for AI security, enabling better monitoring and protection of AI systems. The AI Security Control Plane's development and deployment are crucial for ensuring the secure operation of AI technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: AI ethics a priority:SC judges to students at Bennett University
Major AI Developments.summary: Supreme Court judges emphasized the importance of AI ethics to students at Bennett University. The judges highlighted the need for prioritizing ethics in artificial intelligence development and use. This interaction aimed to raise awareness among future professionals about responsible AI practices.

Major AI Developments.title: Futuristic makeover for Lutyens’ Delhi ahead of AI Summit 2026
Major AI Developments.summary: Lutyens' Delhi is set to undergo a futuristic makeover ahead of the AI Summit 2026. The makeover aims to transform the area into a modern and technologically advanced hub. The exact details of the makeover are not specified, but it is expected to be completed before the AI Summit 2026.

Major AI Developments.title: Agentic AI platform Vibrium raises $1 Mn in seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Vibrium, an agentic AI platform, has raised $1 million in a seed funding round from investors including Paytm's ex-COO Bhavesh Gupta. The funds will be used to accelerate product development and scale enterprise deployments across various sectors. Vibrium's platform is designed to deliver measurable business outcomes through autonomous intelligence, and will focus on strengthening its goal-oriented AI agent framework.

Major AI Developments.title: Delhi man critical after taking HIV preventive drugs on AI advice
Major AI Developments.summary: A Delhi man is in critical condition after taking HIV preventive drugs without a prescription, based on advice from an AI chatbot. The medication led to a rare and serious condition called Stevens-Johnson syndrome. The incident highlights the risks of relying on AI advice for medical decisions without consulting a healthcare professional.

Major AI Developments.title: AI and unstructured data: A roadmap for India's digital transformation with elastic CEO
Major AI Developments.summary: Elastic CEO discusses India's digital transformation roadmap, focusing on AI and unstructured data. The conversation highlights the importance of leveraging AI to extract insights from unstructured data, driving business growth and innovation. India's digital transformation is expected to be fueled by effective management and utilization of this data.

Major AI Developments.title: CBDT awards ₹3000 crore contract to LTIMindtree for building AI-powered tax analytics platform
Major AI Developments.summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has awarded a ₹3000 crore contract to LTIMindtree for developing an AI-powered tax analytics platform. The platform aims to enhance the Income Tax Department's analytical capabilities, enabling faster and more data-driven decision-making. This project is expected to significantly improve the department's overall efficiency.

AI Start-Up News.title: Unnati Agri secures Rs 17 Cr in growth capital from Recur Club
AI Start-Up News.summary: Unnati Agri has secured Rs 17 crore in debt funding from Recur Club, an AI-native debt platform. The Noida-based agri-input platform has previously raised over $13.24 million in equity from investors, including NABVENTURES. The new funding will be used to enhance working capital, inventory procurement, and distribution capabilities.

AI Start-Up News.title: Pet healthcare startup Vetic raises $40 Mn led by Bessemer
AI Start-Up News.summary: Pet healthcare startup Vetic has raised $40 million in a funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors. Bessemer had also backed the company's earlier funding rounds, and had been reported to lead a new funding round for Vetic as early as May 2025. The fresh funding will be used to expand Vetic's operations.

AI Start-Up News.title: IIT Delhi alumnus co-founded Coram AI raises $35 million in Series B
AI Start-Up News.summary: Coram AI, co-founded by an IIT Delhi alumnus, has raised $35 million in Series B funding. The company plans to use the funds for AI product development, expanding its go-to-market teams, and strengthening customer success. The investment will also help grow Coram AI's engineering presence in India.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI video generation startup TrueFan AI raises $10M Series A funding
AI Start-Up News.summary: TrueFan AI, a startup that generates AI video content for enterprises, has raised $10M in Series A funding. The company plans to use the funds for international expansion and enhancing its AI infrastructure. The funding will also support enterprise deployment of its technology.

AI Start-Up News.title: KollegeApply crosses 600 institutions; posts Rs 15 Cr revenue in FY26
AI Start-Up News.summary: KollegeApply, a startup simplifying student admissions, has onboarded over 600 institutions in the last fiscal year. The company generated Rs 15 crore in revenue and posted profits in its first fiscal year ending March 2026. KollegeApply's platform uses AI to simplify college discovery, applications, and enrollment for students, colleges, and universities.

AI Start-Up News.title: TiE Delhi-NCR concludes India Innovation Day 2026
AI Start-Up News.summary: TiE Delhi-NCR concluded India Innovation Day 2026 in Gurugram, gathering over 1,200 attendees to discuss India's evolving innovation economy. The 15th edition, themed "Audacity of Now", focused on India's transition to an innovation-first economy, covering sectors like AI, biotech, and space. The event highlighted developments in various fields, including DeepTech, D2C, and quantum computing.

AI Start-Up News.title: Figtree Pharmacy raises seed funding from AJVC Fund
AI Start-Up News.summary: Mumbai-based pharmacy startup Figtree Pharmacy has raised seed funding from AJVC Fund and other investors, with plans to use the funds to strengthen logistics, build its technology stack, and expand operations. The startup aims to scale its network to 25 stores, focusing on neighbourhood-focused pharmacies across Mumbai and Delhi. Figtree was founded in 2025 by Adrit Chaturvedi and Yatin Sharma, with the goal of expanding its private-label medicines and store operations.

AI Start-Up News.title: Legal-tech startup Lawyered bags $2.5 Mn led by Rainmatter and Turbostart
AI Start-Up News.summary: Lawyered, a legal-tech startup, has raised $2.5 million in a pre-Series A funding round co-led by Rainmatter and Turbostart, with participation from existing investor Finvolve. The Gurugram-based startup had previously secured Rs 8.5 crore at a Rs 120 crore pre-money valuation. This funding round brings new investment to support the company's growth.

AI Start-Up News.title: DAAKit raises $138K in pre-seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: DAAKit, a hyperlocal fulfillment and last-mile logistics startup, has raised $138K in a pre-seed funding round led by Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to expand operations, launch new dark stores, and strengthen its technology infrastructure and team. DAAKit was founded in 2024 and operates an asset-light logistics model, currently serving cities including Delhi, Gurugram, and Mumbai.

AI Start-Up News.title: EV mobility startup Trev Mobility raises angel round to expand across Delhi NCR
AI Start-Up News.summary: Trev Mobility, an EV mobility startup, has raised Rs 3.65 crore in an angel funding round from its existing users. The funds will be used to expand its electric vehicle fleet and scale operations across the Delhi NCR region. The startup had previously secured Rs 20 lakh from the Startup India Seed Fund Scheme, and aims to reimagine urban travel in India through sustainable mobility solutions.

AI Start-Up News.title: GIMS expands AI startup clinic to Purvanchal
AI Start-Up News.summary: GIMS is expanding its AI startup clinic to Purvanchal, aiming to support artificial intelligence startups in the region. The expansion is part of GIMS' efforts to promote innovation and entrepreneurship in the field of AI. The clinic will provide resources and guidance to AI startups, helping them grow and develop.

AI Start-Up News.title: Exclusive: PhysicsWallah co-founder Prateek Boob set to invest in Newton School
AI Start-Up News.summary: Newton School, a certification-based technical training platform, is set to raise around Rs 25 crore in fresh funding from Prateek Boob, co-founder of PhysicsWallah, as part of an extension of its Series B round. The investment will be made through the issue of 72,738 Series B1 preference shares at Rs 3,437 per share. This funding comes after a gap of nearly four years for the Gurugram-based company.

AI Start-Up News.title: Peak XV leads $2.5 Mn round in Companion Labs
AI Start-Up News.summary: Companion Labs, a consumer AI company, has raised $2.5 million in a seed funding round led by Peak XV's Surge, with participation from other investors. The company aims to build interactive experiences for India's vernacular and culturally diverse audiences. The funding will be used to accelerate product development.

AI Start-Up News.title: Wootz.work raises $6.6 Mn in Series A round led by Z47
AI Start-Up News.summary: Wootz.work, a B2B engineering equipment marketplace, has raised $6.6 million in a Series A funding round led by Z47. The round also saw participation from existing investors Nexus Venture Partners and AdvantEdge Founders, as well as new investor Stride Ventures. The fresh capital will be used to expand the company's engineering footprint and deepen its manufacturing control systems.

AI Start-Up News.title: The ePlane Company plans $40–50 Mn funding in Series C round: Report
AI Start-Up News.summary: The ePlane Company, an electric aircraft company, is planning to raise $40-50 million in a Series C funding round. Speciale Invest will co-lead the round, which will be a mix of equity and convertible instruments. The Chennai-based company has previously raised $20 million from Speciale Invest and others.

AI Start-Up News.title: India's AI ambitions: Homegrown tech at New Delhi Summit aims for global impact
AI Start-Up News.summary: India's AI ambitions were on display at a New Delhi summit, where homegrown tech companies showcased their innovations. Indian companies, including Bengaluru-based Gnani.ai, debuted new products, such as speech models, highlighting the country's potential to become a global AI power. The summit demonstrated India's growing presence in the AI sector, with companies aiming for global impact.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI consulting startup Navikenz raises $11.6 Mn led by Sekar PRC and Sudip Nandy
AI Start-Up News.summary: Navikenz, an AI consulting startup, has raised $11.6 million in a funding round co-led by Sekar PRC and Sudip Nandy. The Noida-based company had previously secured $8 million in funding, and this new investment will be used to expand its team and technology. Navikenz aims to help enterprises adopt AI-driven solutions to enhance business processes and drive digital transformation.

AI Start-Up News.title: 1Buy.AI raises Rs 32.5 Cr in seed round led by 100Unicorns
AI Start-Up News.summary: 1Buy.AI, a procurement and cost-reduction platform, has raised Rs 32.5 crore in a seed funding round led by 100Unicorns. The funding round also saw participation from investors such as Ashish Kacholia, Gruhas, and FJ Labs. The fresh funds will be used to develop compliant SaaS platforms and expand global data pipes.
